name: Mir Sazzat Hossain
description:
I am working as an AI Engineer at Penta Global Limited, and was previously a research assistant at the Center for Computational & Data Sciences (CCDS), Independent University, Bangladesh. My research is in natural language processing, with a focus on LLM agents, LLM post-training, and the evaluation of language and vision-language models. Currently, I am working on reinforcement learning, adversarial policy optimization, and on-policy self-distillation for LLMs, especially in settings without labeled data. My work has been published at ACL, WACV and AACL.

At Penta, I work on LLM agents for Autodesk Revit, specifically an agentic system that interacts with Revit to build 3D BIM models from 2D drawing files, and a chat assistant inside Revit. During my four and a half years at CCDS, I worked on Bangla NLP and medical benchmarks for language and vision-language models. I also mentored undergraduate thesis students, taught lab sessions at IUB, and served as an instructor at a national workshop on computational biology. I am looking for PhD positions in Computer Science starting Fall 2027.
